version: Naruto Shippuden (Part II), default outfit — proposed, unconfirmed
notes: Two external reference images were downloaded and viewed in full on 2026-11-07 (see docs/02_REFERENCE_NARUTO.md and data/references.json); they are kept outside the repository, so referenceImagesPresent stays 0.
Gap: the turnaround I saw is the blank-period (The Last) outfit; the Shippuden costume was read from a foreshortened colour render, so the proposal extrapolates between them.
Approval metadata is kept here, in the repository, and never in the player save.
Proposal v1 was generated and displayed; my own review lists nine off-model corrections in proposals/README.md. No approval has been given, so nothing is locked.

Approval covers the LOOK of the frames and the concept they share. The engine still draws the procedural rig, so the in-game TEMP tag stays until a sprite set is built from these frames and approved as sprites.

2026-11-08: the user first said the images were approved ('تصاویر تایید شدن') and then corrected it: 'تصویرای انیمیشن تایید نشد' (the animation images were NOT approved). The approval record in assets/characters/approvals.json is kept but marked REVOKED, so the state frames are proposals again: designLocked false, animationBlocked true, TEMP banners on every sheet.
